channel.desc: Tracy, Mary and Tonya are linked by the man they believe could be their father; tensions and unresolved issues have kept them divided, but they've come together to discover if they're truly sisters and to get answers; Dawn says she's had enough of her boyfriend Sean's nonstop accusations of cheating every time she leaves the house; Sean admits his trust issues stem from past relationships, but now he wants Dawn's phone unlocked to prove her loyalty.
